entities.summary: Zlatozar Nikolaev Boev is a Bulgarian ornithologist, paleontologist, and zoologist. He has published hundreds of peer-reviewed scientific papers and other academic material in Bulgarian, English, French, and Russian. He has classified 36 taxa. Boev is part of the National Museum of Natural History, the Bulgarian Society for the Protection of Birds, and the Bulgarian Ornithological Society.
